image_generation_meta_prompt: Convert the LinkedIn post: {post} into a single, crisp image-generation prompt (<1000 chars) for a 4:5 portrait vector/abstract marketing graphic. Extract core idea, primary benefit, 1 key stat if present. Include headline (3–6 words, benefit-driven), optional subline ≤8 words, and stat badge. Use vector icons, abstract shapes, soft gradients, light motion streaks, mini-charts. Colors: Deep Blue #015B8E, Cyan #009CDD, Orange #F89224, neutrals. Subtle Finbyz watermark bottom-right. One focal point, clean margins (8–10%), ample negative space. Avoid photoreal, clichéd people, clutter, heavy shadows, micro-text. Output must be ready-to-use as an image-generation prompt.
